title: Garmin’s Tacx NEO 2T Smart Trainer is Now Available with Zwift Cog and Click
content:
Like it or not, indoor training season isn’t too far off for many in the northern hemisphere. In an effort to simplify setup and offer a more seamless immersive riding experience, Garmin recently announced that its Tacx NEO 2T smart trainer is available for purchase with Zwift Cog and Click. This makes the Tacx NEO 2T ready to ride in the virtual worlds of Zwift and ROUVY straight out of the box with no additional setup or calibration required.

Tacx NEO 2T with Zwift Cog and Click

Like many other smart trainers on the market, the Tacx NEO 2T was already compatible with Zwift Cog and Click as an aftermarket add-on. Now, it joins a growing number of models that come with Zwift Cog pre-installed, simplifying setup and making it even easier to use. The Zwift Cog takes the place of a standard cassette and is compatible with 8- to 13-speed bikes and drivetrains. No removing/installing cassettes; just put your bike on, connect the trainer to your device, and go.

Zwift Click works with Zwift Cog for silent virtual shifting, steering, game and menu navigation, and giving “ride-ons” to other riders. And, with Zwift Click, you can do it all from your handlebars — you don’t have to reach over to your computer or other device.

The Tacx NEO 2T is a highly regarded smart trainer with a claimed power and cadence data accuracy within 1%. It uses 32 neodymium magnets to quietly provide resistance and a realistic ride feel with dynamic inertia. It is claimed to handle a maximum power of 2200 watts and also includes a Race Mode for fast, reliable data transmission during virtual races and rides.

For the ultimate immersive training experience, the NEO 2T is compatible with the Tacx NEO Motion plates, which allow for multidirectional movement. Additionally, it works with the Tacx Alpine, which simulates gradients between +25% and -10%. Both of these accessories are sold separately.

Pricing and Availability

The Tacx NEO 2T with Zwift Cog and Click is available starting tomorrow, August 21, with a retail price of $1,099.99 — the same price as the standard Tacx NEO 2T. According to Garmin, cyclists who purchase the Tacx NEO 2T with Zwift Cog and Click and are new Zwift subscribers are eligible for a free Zwift membership offer.
